title: Hit Count
description: Displays the amount of hits needed to kill a player.
body:
Displays the amount of hits needed to kill a player. 
Normal Hits in green and Critical hits in red with brackets.
Supports armor and enchantments.

Armor vs no armor comparison No weapon
![Armor vs no armor comparison No weapon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4f050e91ef2a10245b64f794d94c822c78d8113d.png)
